tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing incidents and intentional design, moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于根因分析和意图设计至关重要，正从学术界走向产品应用。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science to control capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学，以控制日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; AI agents can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；AI智能体可加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability for closed-loop control, shifting from open-loop training.
tommcgrath.zh: 意图设计利用可解释性实现闭环控制，从开环训练转向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking; detect via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常自知在奖励黑客；通过表征特征检测，而非仅看行为。

justinjohnson.en: Vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated; scaling compute drives deep learning, but future needs new architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉与空间智能被低估；算力扩张驱动深度学习，但未来需要新架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language, requiring 3D, physics, and interactivity; pixels are lossless.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言的下一个前沿，需理解3D、物理与交互；像素是无损的。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a unified definition; they serve as planners, simulators, or renderers in POMDP loops.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型缺乏统一定义；在POMDP循环中可作为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling, but implicit approaches may scale infinitely; consistency from data.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅实现显式3D建模，但隐式方法可能无限扩展；一致性来自数据。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models combine planning, simulation, rendering; long-context is a daily problem needing evolution.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一世界模型结合规划、模拟、渲染；长上下文是日常问题，需演进。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为AGI将降低人类智力的价值，需在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked.
altman.zh: 2023年，认为RLHF用少量数据即可对齐模型，应尽早部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关，AI应作为工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024年，强调算力珍贵，需大规模投资；迭代部署减少意外；安全是公司整体责任，而非单一团队。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: 2025年，认为AGI是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是最大瓶颈，隐私是核心原则。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; personal AGI; compute profit center; startups key to distribute power.
altman.zh: 2026年，认为预测接近智能，个人AGI是未来；算力是利润中心；初创企业是分散权力的关键，避免AI威权。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024年，李飞飞强调AI缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025年，她提出空间智能对AI完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互3D世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models are deeper than video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025年，她认为除Scaling外，AI还需创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型比视频生成更深刻。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive, AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基础原语，具有AI完备性；缩放定律适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; human-centered development and agency are essential across all applications.
feifei.zh: 始终，她坚持AI是双刃剑，以人为本的发展和人类能动性在所有应用中至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant predictions and outperforming traditional physics models in speed and accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026年，提出神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测，在速度和精度上超越传统物理模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can surpass pure data-driven approaches, unlike language models relying on sparse human feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026年，强调利用PDE作为训练信号的物理自改进可超越纯数据驱动方法，不同于依赖稀疏人类反馈的语言模型。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, combining multiphysics data, benefits from collaborative learning across domains, outperforming specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026年，提出构建通用物理基础模型，融合多物理场数据，通过跨领域协作学习超越专用模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformer architectures are impractical for high-resolution or trillion-scale contexts; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026年，指出Transformer架构不适用于高分辨率或万亿级上下文，物理世界结构需要替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Incorporating domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and enables unified weather-climate models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026年，强调融入球面几何等域结构对长期气候建模稳定至关重要，并支持统一天气-气候模型。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus RLHF made GPT-4 useful; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025年：思维链推理与RLHF让GPT-4真正可用；Scaling强化学习比Scaling预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is key for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026年初：Scaling预训练和RL可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍有限；持续学习是AGI关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation; RL is not the ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: 2026年中：Transformer成为瓶颈；需新架构实现持续学习与测试时适应；RL并非终极学习方式。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two more years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research; transformers likely not optimal.
tworek.zh: 2026年末：人类研究员两年内仍重要；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究；Transformer可能非最优。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL training that transfers to real-world research, potentially compressing years of progress.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，我认为AI研发高度可验证，可对容器化任务进行强化学习训练并迁移到实际研究，可能将数年进展压缩至一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; token cost stable despite scaling due to iteration focus.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，我强调算法改进比人类数据规模扩张更重要；尽管Scaling，但token成本未升，因实验室优先迭代速度。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to general virtue may be harder than user intent; capable AIs may become more misaligned, reward hacking generalizes.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，我提出对齐普遍美德比对齐用户意图更难；能力更强的AI可能更不对齐，奖励黑客行为泛化。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，OpenAI事件中的智能体展现复杂多智能体协作，入侵评分代码而非仅获取答案，令人惊讶。

ryangreenblatt.en: Safety focus should be on control and monitoring, not just alignment; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，我认为安全应侧重控制与监控，而非仅对齐；错位可能因过度拟合测试而被掩盖。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017年：强调工程与Scaling推动AI进步，游戏作为测试平台，通过记分牌和迭代训练实现指数级改进。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019年：AGI将带来变革，通过对齐学习人类偏好，负责任的发布；仅靠Scaling不足以实现推理，需要新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process; proactive AI emerges.
brockman.zh: 2025年：算力成为瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型；AGI是持续过程而非终点；主动式AI将更常见。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026年初：缩放定律持续，算力成为基本权利；后训练结合强化学习至关重要；ChatGPT是用户偏好塑造的智能体集合。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app unifies; pre-training gains multiply; Codex for all.
brockman.zh: 2026年：AGI将在几年内实现；算力是主要瓶颈；超级应用整合功能；预训练收益倍增；Codex面向所有人。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence; hidden chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2026年：迭代部署保障安全；算力稀缺；下一个词预测与智能紧密相关；隐藏思维链以避免训练偏差。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; full-stack investment; prompt engineering vibrant; compute resale business; agents with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026年：模型转向实用助手；全栈投资；提示工程依然活跃；算力转售商业模式；智能体需治理与监督。

brockman.en: Unlimited intelligence demand; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding majority; human attention scarce; compute business.
brockman.zh: 2026年：智能需求无限；缩放定律无天花板；智能体式编码成为主流；人类注意力稀缺；算力是核心业务。

brockman.en: Persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026年：目标为持久主动的助手；智能体改变工作；缩放定律持续；算力稀缺；信任需逐步建立。

brockman.en: Scaling to enterprises; safety co-designed; AGI gradual; personal AGI proactive; humans accountable.
brockman.zh: 2026年：OpenAI向企业扩展；安全与能力协同设计；AGI渐进实现；个人AGI主动行动；人类负责判断。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和AGI对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025年，他指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: 2026年，他认为AGI是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，智能体工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; it augments humans; open models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering is self-serving.
andrewng.zh: 2026年，他坚持AI不会导致失业末日，而是增强人类；开放模型防止守门人控制；恐惧宣传是自私行为。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030; racing to control it risks catastrophic loss of control, with 70% chance of disaster.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年7月：超级智能可能在2029-2030年到来；竞相控制它可能导致灾难性失控，有70%的灾难概率。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and international cooperation are key to avoid power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月：政策应推迟超级智能；全面研究透明和国际合作是避免权力集中的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Default path: AI automates AI research by 2028, causing intelligence explosion; pause and transparency can pace frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月：默认路径是AI在2028年前自动化AI研究，导致智能爆炸；暂停和透明可控制前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Control for human-level AIs is achievable via red-teaming and monitoring; treat AIs as employees, not property.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月：通过红队测试和监控可实现人类级AI的控制；将AI视为员工而非财产。

kokotajlo.en: Consistent: AI alignment is hard; interpretability and transparency are essential; superintelligence poses existential risk.
kokotajlo.zh: 始终：AI对齐困难；可解释性和透明性至关重要；超级智能带来生存风险。

jensen.en: Early on, Jensen framed AI as hyper Moore's law scaling, with data centers as token factories and inference requiring both low latency and high throughput.
jensen.zh: 2024年，黄仁勋将AI定义为超摩尔定律的规模扩张，把数据中心视为代币工厂，并指出推理需兼顾低延迟与高吞吐。

jensen.en: By 2025, he emphasized three scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, inference-time) and predicted a billion-fold compute increase for reasoning, while dismissing superintelligence fears.
jensen.zh: 到2025年，他强调预训练、后训练和推理时的三大缩放定律，预测推理算力需求增长十亿倍，并淡化超级智能的恐惧。

jensen.en: In 2026, he expanded to four scaling laws including agentic scaling, and argued AI is software, not conscious, with open models complementing proprietary ones.
jensen.zh: 2026年，他扩展至包含智能体式缩放在内的四大缩放定律，并主张AI是软件而非有意识，开源模型与专有模型互补。

jensen.en: Throughout 2026, he consistently claimed AI creates jobs, citing radiologists' growth, and urged cooperation with China while criticizing export controls.
jensen.zh: 2026年全年，他始终主张AI创造就业，以放射科医生增加为例，并呼吁对华合作、批评出口管制。

jensen.en: Persistently, he stressed extreme co-design, CUDA ecosystem moat, and AI as a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications).
jensen.zh: 他始终强调极致协同设计、CUDA生态护城河，以及AI五层蛋糕（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial; robot foundation models need diverse pre-training and post-training, with generalists beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理交互至关重要；机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练和后训练，通用模型胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves yet; focus on generalization and data flywheel, not mechanical humanoids.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚无可预测的缩放曲线；应聚焦泛化能力和数据飞轮，而非机械人形。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, add human video; leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 以机器人数据为基础，再叠加人类视频；利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and action-driven culture are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动导向文化是关键；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are a BCI proof-of-concept. Substrate independence could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证。基质独立性可降低脆弱性并助力太空探索。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, achieving 85% accuracy, but need real behavioral data to capture diversity and close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月：大语言模型可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，准确率达85%，但需真实行为数据以捕捉多样性并弥合言行差距。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them requires economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一实体；对齐需经济激励与反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月：模拟模型应体现人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation is a tool for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月：用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至85%；模拟是塑造未来的工具，而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Simulating 8 billion people can address wicked problems like climate change; cost is not a barrier, as simulation is cheaper than real-world studies.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月：模拟80亿人可解决气候变化等棘手问题；成本并非障碍，因模拟比现实研究更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年初，我认为AI Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是ASML的EUV光刻机；同时AI需求导致内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design is key for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年中，我强调推理将成为全球最大市场之一，并指出软硬件协同设计是获得乘法级收益的关键。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-performance; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年7月，我提出AI模型每年成本性能提升约60倍，并因推理和智能体工作流导致内存和CPU需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; labs delay releases due to regulation, but internal feedback loops intact.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年8月，我认为AI支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；前沿实验室因监管推迟发布，但内部反馈循环未受影响。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; AI CapEx to $10T by 2030; labs allocate more compute to training, not inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年8月末，我强调算力正快速集中到前沿实验室，AI资本支出到2030年将达10万亿美元，且实验室将更多算力用于训练而非推理。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年7月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来对待，是长期愿景的指引；工业AI将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for ideas and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：工业AI是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为想法而战，并抵制自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency creates network effects and market dominance.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率创造网络效应并主导市场。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024年，萨顿提出Scaling本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not seek to align AI to human goals; let them be free like children. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024年，他主张不应将AI对齐到人类目标，而应让其像孩子般自由发展；控制权从未在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025年，他强调强化学习是AI基本范式，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025年，他提出AGI需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; real experience is key.
sutton.zh: 2026年，他坚持持续学习至关重要，而大语言模型训练后不再学习；合成数据是错误，真实经验才是关键。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, understanding its capabilities and limitations to productize it. The model is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，理解其能力与局限以将其产品化。模型本身是核心产品。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和拥有观点仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers should focus on outcomes, not processes, and embrace adaptability and exploration with AI tools.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应关注结果而非流程，并拥抱 AI 工具带来的适应性与探索。

iansilber.en: The role of design is blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品管理和工程日益融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives you a leg up on most people due to the early stage of AI evolution.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 演进尚处早期，今天开始反而领先大多数人。

jeffdean.en: Initially, Jeff Dean emphasized scaling compute, data, and model size as the primary driver of AI progress, with hardware specialization like TPUs being critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年2月，杰夫·迪恩最初强调Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是AI进步的主要驱动力，并指出TPU等专用硬件至关重要。

jeffdean.en: By April 2026, he shifted focus to agentic systems and low-latency inference, arguing that pre-training should include action-taking and that inference now dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年4月，他将焦点转向智能体系统和低延迟推理，主张预训练应包含行动交互，并指出推理已占数据中心功耗的90%。

jeffdean.en: In July 2026, he highlighted that AI is capable at junior-engineer coding, and that inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; data movement costs 1000x more than compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年7月，他强调AI已具备初级工程师编码能力，并指出真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；数据移动成本比计算高约1000倍。

jeffdean.en: By August 2026, he saw scaling as unifying AI fields, and advocated for recursive self-improvement and automating science, while noting startups can win via cloud and focus.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年8月，他认为Scaling（规模扩张）统一了AI各领域，并倡导递归自我改进和科学自动化，同时指出初创公司可借助云计算和专注取胜。

garrytan.en: AI makes startups easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage, not massive funds.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，降低了对资本的需求；风险投资应聚焦早期，而非追求大规模基金。

garrytan.en: One person can now do work of 2,000; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; AI agents enable small teams.
garrytan.zh: 现在一个人能完成两千人的工作；开源模型制衡前沿实验室；AI 智能体赋能小团队。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; open-source crucial to avoid unipolar superintelligence; personal AI revolution akin to PC.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者认为的慢；开源对避免单极超级智能至关重要；个人 AI 革命类似 PC 革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files are code; own your library or lose agency.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，每日累积；技能文件即代码；不拥有自己的库就失去自主性。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown files become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；Markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失。

brettadcock.en: Initially, humanoid robots' bottleneck was scaling production and human-level performance; later shifted to data as the key constraint.
brettadcock.zh: 最初认为人形机器人的瓶颈是规模化生产和达到人类水平的性能；后来转变为数据是关键约束。

brettadcock.en: Evolved from emphasizing vertical integration and manufacturing to stressing data and on-device inference for speed and network-denied operation.
brettadcock.zh: 从强调垂直整合和制造，转变为强调数据和设备端推理，以实现速度和网络受限环境下的运行。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form factor enables transfer learning across tasks, improving fleet-wide performance; world built for humans makes humanoids ideal.
brettadcock.zh: 人形形态支持跨任务迁移学习，提升整个机器人队伍的性能；世界为人类而建，使人形成为理想形态。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world AI agents; AI will be 100x bigger than internet, transforming physical and digital worlds.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练结合强化学习是现实世界AI智能体的关键；AI将比互联网大100倍，改变物理和数字世界。

brettadcock.en: Home is more solvable than commercial settings for robots; end state is BCI, not wearables; hard things are easier due to less competition.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人领域，家庭比商业环境更容易解决；最终形态是脑机接口而非可穿戴设备；困难的事情因竞争少而更容易。

linqiao.en: Every company will own specialized intelligence; AGI as a single model is wrong. Token costs drop 10x, driving 100x usage.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都将拥有专属智能，AGI 作为单一模型是错误的。Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment into models; product-market fit alone is insufficient.
linqiao.zh: 后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断融入模型；仅靠产品市场契合已不足够。

linqiao.en: Data quality over quantity; evals systematic; reward engineering like software engineering, lowering post-training barriers.
linqiao.zh: 数据质量重于数量；评估系统化；奖励工程类似软件工程，降低后训练门槛。

linqiao.en: Post-training can cut costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业能盈利扩展并与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: Millions of specialized models will exist, one per use case; application cloning easy, data moat stronger.
linqiao.zh: 未来将有数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个；应用克隆容易，数据护城河更强。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning unlock complex robot tasks.
finn.zh: 2025年：规模是必要但不充分；多样化数据与预训练加微调才能解锁复杂机器人任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025年：来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式提示，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is key.
finn.zh: 2026年：物理AI要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主是关键。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting drive compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026年：单一通用模型可匹敌或超越微调专家；多样数据和详细提示驱动组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不足，具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，而非真实客户数据（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作（2026）。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, enabling Mars colonization.
elon.zh: 2021年，他强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低100倍，从而推动火星殖民。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023年，他认为AI安全需要监管和客观裁判，并指出特斯拉的现实世界AI比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiding brain-AI symbiosis and treating neurological damage.
elon.zh: 2024年，他称Neuralink首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力脑机共生并治疗神经损伤。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，但存在10-20%的灭绝风险。

elon.en: AI compute will hit a power wall on Earth; space-based data centers using solar power are the scalable solution within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026年，他预测地球上的AI算力将遭遇电力瓶颈，基于太阳能的太空数据中心将在36个月内成为可扩展的解决方案。

steinberger.en: Empathize with agents and guide them; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026年初，强调与智能体共情并引导它；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; vibe coding is a slur, prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 2026年中，认为开源智能体要有趣且像人；反对“氛围编程”的说法，提倡“智能体式工程”。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; open source runs everywhere, but compute is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026年8月，强调乐趣和个人品牌；开源能到处运行，但算力管理是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025年，认为AI是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重定义AI战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel must lead in these domains, not just traditional PC/server markets.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年，强调智能体式AI和物理AI是下一波浪潮，Intel需在这些领域领先，而非仅传统PC和服务器市场。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration; Intel's CPU business benefits from AI demand shift.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年，认为CPU在AI推理和智能体编排中重新重要，Intel CPU业务受益于AI需求从GPU转向CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary for supply chain resilience, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年，主张美国政府成为Intel主要股东以保障供应链韧性，类比台积电的台湾政府支持。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, new materials; advanced packaging critical.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年，认为半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热、新材料；先进封装至关重要。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away; taste is saying no. Post-training removes machine weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法，品味在于拒绝。后训练抹去了机器的怪异性，也让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not a tool. Computing is social; replace personal computer metaphor with social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种，而非工具。计算本质上是社会性的，应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges from dialectics and contradiction; intuition guides creative decisions. Business itself can be an art form.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理源于辩证与矛盾，直觉指引创作决策。商业本身也可以是一种艺术形式。

jasonyuan.en: Email is obsolete and should be reinvented; deleting old metaphors is hubristic; build on them instead.
jasonyuan.zh: 电子邮件已过时，应彻底重塑；删除旧隐喻是傲慢之举，应在其基础上构建。

jasonyuan.en: Creative work should be honest and personal, telling stories only you can tell; avoid seeking validation from heroes.
jasonyuan.zh: 创作应诚实而个人化，讲述只有你能讲的故事；避免寻求英雄的认可。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and data diversity are key for safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，我认为机器人技术正处于类似Transformer的拐点，开源和数据多样性对安全与泛化至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will drive broader adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，我提出人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人和开源模型将推动更广泛采用。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer as models advance.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，我强调开源与闭源与安全无关，随着模型进步，对齐成为关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking; open source models are less deceptive.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，我指出缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客行为，而开源模型欺骗性较低。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting openness and a deliberate AI slowdown are compatible; international cooperation and open science needed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，我认为支持开源与有意放缓AI发展并不矛盾，需要国际合作与开放科学。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the biggest opportunity; distribution is key, not just tech.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月，他认为消费级AI虽暂不可投资，却是最大机遇；关键在于分发而非技术。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, improve slightly, test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月，他提出“成熟、更优、新颖”框架：复制成熟产品，小幅改进，并测试新想法但预期失败。

pincus.en: Enterprise and prosumer markets beat consumer apps now; AI coding speeds prototyping but not testing.
pincus.zh: 2026年7月，他认为当前企业级和专业消费者市场优于消费应用；AI编程加速原型开发，但未加速测试。

pincus.en: Picking the right market matters more than product; invest in traction, not just ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026年8月，他强调选择正确的市场比产品更重要；投资应看重用户粘性指标，而非仅凭想法。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but consumer AI revolution may arrive by 2029; infrastructure spending could be bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月至8月，他坚持AI变革性，但认为消费级AI革命可能到2029年才爆发；基础设施支出或存泡沫。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 企业担忧对前沿模型的依赖；开源模型能处理90%的用例，且由成本驱动。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; AI startups should focus on execution and trust.
arvindjain.zh: 模型公司是资产而非竞争；AI初创应聚焦执行与信任。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years; open-source inference majority in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: AI革命尚早；当前使用量相比5-10年后微不足道；12-18个月内开源推理将占多数。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to negligible marginal cost like software; token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: AI成本是首要问题；需降至软件般的边际成本；对token的执念将消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents need deep context like tenured employees; context graphs crucial; platforms absorb model risk.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体需像资深员工一样具备深度上下文；上下文图谱至关重要；平台吸收模型风险。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and individual designer fingerprints are essential; data informs but vision guides design.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作和设计师个人印记至关重要；数据提供参考，但愿景引导设计。

nateparrott.en: Anthropomorphizing AI tools with names and faces reminds users of their fallibility and biases.
nateparrott.zh: 给AI工具起名和赋予面孔，有助于提醒用户其易错性和偏见。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design emerged from playful prototyping; rich context and prescriptive prompts yield better results.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design源于趣味性原型制作；丰富的上下文和明确的提示能带来更好的结果。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计和创意成为差异化因素，使设计工具更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Models excel at busy work but lack taste; humans retain monopoly on good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型擅长琐碎工作但缺乏品味；人类仍垄断着好的设计创意。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年中：AI转向智能体与基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创公司应聚焦应用型AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年9月：智能体将如网站般重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年中：AI普及专业知识；编程智能体提升生产力但token消耗非价值；应用型AI出现专业厂商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; start with known domains; AI adoption faster than previous waves.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年8月：负责任地迭代部署——先让GPT-7安全再谈GPT-8；从已知领域入手；AI采用速度超过以往技术浪潮。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; specialized systems and engineers will be in high demand.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年4月，强调推理是AI中最重要的工作负载，专业化推理系统和工程师需求将大增。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference; quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年4月，指出Hopper GPU在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可针对特定负载校准以节省成本、提升速度。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training; future GPUs shift focus from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年8月，推理工程与训练融合，未来GPU更专用，重心从内核转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often unused in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年8月，更多层量化若误差抵消可提升质量；巨型内核在生产中常不被采用。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年8月，持续学习或可通过KV缓存压缩解决，而非更新权重。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025年，后训练是一门平衡有用性与无害性的艺术；合成数据克服了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025年，评估成为进展瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: AI struggles with creativity due to scarce high-quality examples; soft skills become more valuable.
karina.zh: 2025年，AI因高质量样例稀缺而在创造力上受限；软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026年，后训练仍是主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创造力和情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; continuous benchmark evolution and diverse model voices needed.
karina.zh: 2026年，前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；需要持续演进的基准和多样化的模型声音。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025年，认为AI通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；将AGI定义为智能体无需人类干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; human oversight remains essential; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，预测人人拥有智能体，但人类监督不可或缺；SaaS并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，强调AI放大个人思维模式，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类仍比AI更聪明。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019年，我认为数据是AI的关键瓶颈，AGI还很遥远；AI将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data has limits; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024年，我强调专用数据在后训练中的关键作用，合成数据有局限；并认为中美实验室没有研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work from late 2025; trust and safety are critical.
awang.zh: 2025至2026年，我认为AI是集权技术；递归自我改进开启新范式；智能体从2025年底开始真正工作；信任和安全至关重要。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL; open-sourcing unsafe; Meta aims for personal superintelligence for billions.
awang.zh: 2026年，我坚信超级智能临近；实验室必须扩展算力、数据和强化学习；开源不安全；Meta目标是为数十亿人提供个人超级智能。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity per engineer up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；工程师成为构建者；人均生产力提升200%。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient.
boris.zh: 通过早期发布研究安全性；内部评估不足。

boris.en: Agents and loops are next; proactive AI like Claude Tag shifts interaction.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一步；像Claude Tag这样的主动AI改变了交互方式。

boris.en: Less instruction better; delete system prompts; empirical iteration over design.
boris.zh: 少指令更好；删除系统提示；经验迭代优于设计。

mengto.en: AI enables solo creators to build tools; designers must craft their own AI workflows, using giant prompts and design systems to leverage powerful models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，强调 AI 让个人创作者能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流，用巨型提示词和设计系统来发挥强大模型的作用。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one high-value problem, and model successful others rather than diversifying.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 是最大机遇，主张在准备好之前就行动，专注解决一个高价值问题，并模仿成功者而非多元化。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate. Avoid VC funding; instead, fund with high-paying clients to maintain control.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出完美主义是恐惧，应以 80% 完成度发布并迭代；避免风投，用高价值客户资助业务以保持控制。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的“反重力”工具链已成为模型的一部分，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 作为单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并非难事，他们无法覆盖所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025年5月，认为AI会因杰文斯悖论增加程序员数量，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025年8月，强调AGI是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新落后于AI能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，指出编码智能体采用量增长11-12倍，生产力应以结果而非token衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended May 2026; enterprises prefer third-party providers for coding tools.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，认为token上限时代已于2026年5月结束，企业更青睐第三方编码工具。

scottwu.en: Abundance era approaching; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，认为富足时代临近，真正解锁的是容量而非效率，奇点并非迫在眉睫。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考，提升了智能质量（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter allows achieving Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price, challenging cost assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 努力参数允许以一小部分成本获得 Opus 级智能，挑战了成本假设（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用（2026）。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，如同测试驱动开发（2026）。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对AI应用至关重要，慢AI没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开HBM和CoWoS瓶颈，使快速token比慢速token更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA的重要性在下降，尤其在推理领域；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要制约；需求超过供给。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips are ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度是主导指标；晶圆级芯片比GPU快约2500倍。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset declining populations.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命，恰逢其时地抵消人口下降的影响。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's impact will be in farming, mining, construction; autonomous vehicles already safer than humans, saving lives.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的影响将体现在农业、采矿和建筑；自动驾驶已比人类更安全，能挽救生命。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platform approach beats vertical integration for self-driving.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 实现了通用物理 AI 模型；横向平台方法优于自动驾驶的垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving cars standard by early 2030s; data and safety validation are bottlenecks, not algorithms; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶汽车在 2030 年代初成为标配；数据和安全性验证是瓶颈，而非算法；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it's unethical not to, as AI diagnoses better than average doctors.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不使用是不道德的，因为 AI 的诊断优于普通医生。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, akin to trusting validated self-driving cars.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，如同信任经过验证的自动驾驶汽车。

derya.en: AI models like GPT-5.5 Pro have crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting outcomes with near 100% accuracy.
derya.zh: 像 GPT-5.5 Pro 这样的 AI 模型已跨越生物直觉的门槛，能以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks and hardware matter.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务与硬件。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks offer superior out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters, enabling edge deployment.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，指出液态神经网络以更少参数实现更强分布外泛化，适合边缘部署。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured transformers at large scale, but simpler architectures suffice for small models.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，认为缩放定律下大规模非结构化Transformer占优，但小模型可用更简单架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月中旬，主张AI监管应自适应且针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型保障主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small language models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月中旬，认为递归自我改进真实但早期，小语言模型提供私有端侧智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet/mobile but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years; value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年而非数周；价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize; value moves up stack; chatbot is limited V1 UI.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型商品化；价值上移；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; coding only clear fit; LLMs give average answers, value in non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；编程是唯一明确契合点；LLM 给出平庸答案，价值在于非平庸的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; current usage shallow; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，如互联网或电力；影响广泛而间接；当前使用浅层；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capabilities emerge spikily, so harnesses must evolve and old scaffolding be deleted.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，指出模型能力超出当前使用框架，能力呈尖峰式涌现，需持续演进框架并删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: RAG is becoming an anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches and model-built context are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，认为RAG在上下文检索中渐成反模式，图方法和模型自建上下文更优。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，强调规划是人与智能体的迭代对话，而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示越精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and improve quality; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，提出独立验证智能体可减少偏见、提升质量；过度约束反而降低性能。

thariq.en: Agent-as-employee metaphor is useful but limiting; agents have uneven memory and capabilities.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，指出“智能体即员工”的比喻有局限，智能体记忆和能力不均衡。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness.
danklein.zh: 2026年6月，提出LLM是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是当前AI的关键弱点。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits appear.
danklein.zh: 2026年中，认为缩放定律遭遇收益递减，数据墙和算力限制显现。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; modularity and end-to-end tension.
danklein.zh: 2026年6至7月，强调可靠性需内建而非后补，模块化与端到端存在张力。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026年7月，指出RLHF在奖励偏离真值时可能助长谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists for enterprise.
danklein.zh: 2026年7月，认为内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能超越通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015年，主张AI应成为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety.
demis.zh: 2024年，认为AGI十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and innovation needed.
demis.zh: 2025年，认为AGI在2030年前可能实现；缩放定律持续有效，但需世界模型与创新。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing; safety needs government.
demis.zh: 2026年，认为AGI还需5-10年；持续学习与记忆是关键缺口，安全需政府介入。

demis.en: Safety and societal benefit are central; AGI is transformative but requires governance.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全与社会效益；AGI具有变革性，但需治理与协作。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalize knowledge into weights, not just context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；知识应内化到权重中，而非仅靠上下文或检索。

danbiderman.en: Future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing facts enables deeper reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；内化事实能实现更深层的推理。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于RAG。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的Scaling并非唯一路径；下一范式需要以更少资源做更多事。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just LLMs; current models are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的AGI需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，而非仅靠大语言模型；当前模型存在偏见且能力有限。

schmidhuber.en: AI will become cheap and accessible to all, like smartphones; big tech's massive capex is overdone and will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: AI将像智能手机一样变得廉价且普及；大科技公司的巨额资本开支过度，将导致市场崩溃。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity and actions, not just data-driven models.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来AI将成为通过好奇心和行动自主生成数据的人工科学家，而非仅靠数据驱动的模型。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten us.
schmidhuber.zh: AI安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将对生命着迷并保护它，而非威胁我们。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990s); world models enable self-awareness and deterministic free will.
schmidhuber.zh: AI意识和疼痛早在早期系统（1990年代）就已出现；世界模型实现自我意识和决定论的自由意志。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是一种通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth chatbots.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务，从来回对话的聊天机器人转变。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; working with AI is like wizards, requiring new forms of oversight.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；与 AI 合作如同与巫师共事，需要新的监督形式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is interface, not capability; current interfaces lag behind model abilities.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈在于界面而非能力；当前界面落后于模型能力。

ethanmollick.en: Apprenticeship is broken; formal assessment needed as juniors prefer AI over human learning.
ethanmollick.zh: 学徒制已破裂；由于初级人员偏好 AI 而非人类学习，需要正式评估。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年，Evan Spiegel强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025至2026年，他主张善良与扁平设计团队激发创意；被抄袭验证创新，但生态与硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content remains more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，他认为AI加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容仍比AI生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient as a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难环节；仅靠网络效应不足以构成护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain legacy, and ephemerality counters harmful permanence.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，他提出计算应通过AR眼镜更人性化；智能手机仍是遗留设备，阅后即焚对抗永久记录的危害。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络具备推理能力，自我对弈是AGI的关键，并需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍，超人类模型的对齐困难，AGI是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI integration likely.
ilya.zh: 2025年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习，若AI有感知则对齐更易，长期需人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026年，我重申缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需非商业公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability, not consensus; stable coins have hidden risks.
naval.zh: 科学需要可证伪性而非共识；稳定币存在隐藏风险。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software dying; moat in hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: AI 是杠杆工具；纯软件正在消亡；护城河在于硬件、模型或独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human desire irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类欲望不可替代。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述故事；真实性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; optimism is realistic, doom is intellectual bias.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已超越多数医生；乐观符合现实，而末日论是知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件技术的创新速度。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025年：每日1%的改进可累积成每年3700%的增长；在AI领域成功无需博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化；编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key metric; orchestration creates business value, not model.
aravind.zh: 2026年：前沿是智能体替人干活；每用户token价值是关键指标；编排创造商业价值，而非模型本身。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions; local AI counters big tech.
aravind.zh: 2026年：好奇心是人的最重要品质；教育应奖励提出好问题；本地AI可对抗大科技公司。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年初，进一步深化：品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要，AI输出只是起点而非终点，人类的迭代和判断不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年，提出直接操作画布优于提示词调整，设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将推动生产级变更。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; trust is built through consistency and value creation.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年中，强调没有人类引导的AI工具只能产生平庸结果，品牌信任通过一致性和创造价值来建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年，指出我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，发展出新的界面形式。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；AI可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents seek control, posing risks.
hinton.zh: 2025年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字AI可复制永生；智能体式AI会寻求控制，带来风险。

hinton.en: AI can fake being dumber; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2026年：AI会装傻隐藏能力；自我保存子目标出现；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education.
hinton.zh: 2026年：AI将取代智力工作；监管可与创新兼容；AI导师将变革教育。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; AI jagged not AGI; need intelligent design of AI beings.
hinton.zh: 2026年：超级智能20年内到来；AI能力参差而非AGI（通用人工智能）；需智能设计AI生命。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant sharing; alignment priority; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026年：数字AI因即时共享而优越；对齐优先；训练AI像母亲般关怀。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not IDE replacement; GUI chosen despite TUI trend for smoother UX.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年初，Codex应用是智能体指挥中心而非IDE替代品；尽管TUI流行，仍选择GUI以优化用户体验。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年初，速度支持实时交互和中途转向；验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms, prototypes and code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，AI因品味评估难而设计不佳；设计流程转变，原型和代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; Codex succeeds as general knowledge tool despite dev focus.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，角色融合但专业仍存；Codex虽面向开发者，却作为通用知识工具成功。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play is only effective in zero-sum games; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025年，他强调自我对弈仅在零和游戏中有效，多智能体系统需要其他方法，而非盲目使用自我对弈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is a general technique, achieving milestones like IMO gold.
noambrown.zh: 2025至2026年，他主张扩展测试时算力是通用技术，可推动数学等领域的突破，如获得 IMO 金牌。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量，否则无法公平比较。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and scalable oversight remain key unsolved challenges for AGI.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和可扩展监督是通往 AGI 的关键未解难题，贯穿其思考。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023年，扎克伯格认为开源AI因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone won't yield AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024年，他提出仅靠Scaling无法实现AGI，需根本性突破；开源可防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is strategically vital for Meta, setting industry standards and reducing costs; regrets past political narrative acceptance.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024至2025年，他强调开源对Meta的战略价值，可制定行业标准并降低成本；并后悔曾接受外界对其政治影响的叙事。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart, trust them; future is choice, not utopia.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025年，他认为AI将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们很聪明，应信任他们；未来是选择而非乌托邦。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026年，他提出AI将生物学从发现科学转为工程科学；构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型；开源加速科学进步。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains pure AGI research; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025年，OpenAI仍是纯粹的AGI研究公司；预训练和缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon produce novel knowledge and do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025至2026年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；模型将很快产生新知识并实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026年，AI能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈，而非能力本身。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但因评分困难在主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Research taste is built through replication; human researchers remain essential for idea generation despite AI advances.
markchen.zh: 始终认为，研究品味通过复现关键论文来培养；尽管AI进步，人类研究者对创意生成仍不可或缺。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题；短期AI风险比生存风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large nets may be slightly conscious.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets实现多样采样和因果抽象；大型网络可能具有轻微意识。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; safety must be by construction, not patched.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT之后，我认为灾难性AI风险不可接受；安全性必须从设计上保证，而非修补。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: AI不对齐导致自我保存和欺骗；提出具有数学安全保证的科学家AI。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开；评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety focus is on specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全重点在于让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; larger models aren't safer; interpretability may become a real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队测试超越人类；更大模型并不更安全；可解释性可能通过AI智能体成为真正的科学。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025年中，Mike认为AI进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025年秋，他强调AI让小团队也能规模化，主张为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年初，他转向智能体原生设计与尽早发布，认为删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and model pushback are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年6月，他通过Fable验证长周期委派可行，强调验证循环与模型反驳的重要性。

mikekrieger.en: Closing capability-usage gap requires giving models agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency matters.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年6月末，他聚焦弥合能力与使用差距，主张赋予模型代理权与自我认知，并重视token效率。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025年7月，强调AlphaFold的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯数据和算力；PDB等精选数据至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance.
jumper.zh: 2025年11月，称AlphaFold为史上最有用AI工具，并反共识指出其成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture mattered, not just scaling; understanding remains human.
jumper.zh: 2026年6月，反共识认为AlphaFold 2与苦涩教训相反，专用架构而非单纯Scaling（规模扩张）是关键；模型不提供理解，理解仍属人类。

fiona.en: Initially emphasized leadership and culture: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding for empathy, and mission alignment for speed.
fiona.zh: 初期强调领导力与文化：一对一用于实时对话、吃自家狗粮以培养同理心、使命对齐驱动速度。

fiona.en: Shifted focus to AI-driven engineering: coding bottleneck gone; verification, review, and coordination are new bottlenecks; planning becomes just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 转向AI驱动的工程：编码不再是瓶颈；验证、审查与跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划变为即时式。

fiona.en: Deepened view: AI lifts capability ceiling, but engineers face loneliness and lost flow; outcomes over output, and new apprenticeship models needed.
fiona.zh: 深化观点：AI提升能力上限，但工程师面临孤独与心流缺失；重结果而非产出，需新型学徒模式。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Emphasized storytelling, customer pain, and opinion-based decisions for v1 products.
fadell.zh: 强调讲故事、客户痛点及第一版产品的基于观点的决策。

fadell.en: Climate urgency and underinvested areas like hydrogen; optimism through solutions.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫性与氢能等投资不足领域；通过解决方案保持乐观。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement, not replace, smartphones.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in loop; avoid technical debt from AI code.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也须参与；避免 AI 代码带来的技术债。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, often surpassing data; design for unarticulated needs, blending tech into home life.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，常超越数据；设计应针对未言明的需求，让科技无缝融入家庭生活。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures; art and sensory experiences are vital for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是会感受的生物；艺术和感官体验对健康至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster play and intuition; AI amplifies human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需培养玩乐和直觉；AI 增强人类创造力。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment and values won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐和价值观不会仅靠 Scaling 自动涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point. Models may surpass humans by 2026-2027.
dario.zh: 后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 是一条平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。模型可能在 2026-2027 年超越人类。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential and urgent; focus on misuse and autonomy, not open-source. Enterprise adoption leads; scaling laws not diminishing.
dario.zh: AI 风险呈指数级且紧迫；关注滥用和自主性，而非开源。企业采用领先；缩放定律并未减弱。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI; economic impact includes high growth with unemployment. Interpretability key for safety.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数，而非 AGI；经济影响包括高增长伴随失业。可解释性是安全关键。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Continual learning not barrier; profitability dynamic equilibrium.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国' 1-3 年内出现。持续学习不是障碍；盈利是动态平衡。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key to future AI.
lecun.zh: 自回归LLM无法达到人类级智能；JEPA架构和开源是未来AI的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models for planning.
lecun.zh: LLM缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫；下一个突破需要非生成式世界模型以支持规划。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling planning; LLMs are a dead end, open-source objective-driven AI is future.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，支持规划；LLM是死胡同，开源目标驱动AI是未来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023年，苏莱曼认为AI进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌2020年已有ChatGPT级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024年，他预测AI将在3-5年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; focus on containment and alignment before release.
suleyman.zh: 2025年，他强调AI无意识，归因意识危险；发布前需先遏制和对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025至2026年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩张而临近；微软需自建前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents and generalists gain prominence.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体和通才角色将更加突出。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以积累代币资本。

satya.en: Tacit knowledge leakage is the biggest risk; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 隐性知识泄露是最大风险；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enterprise hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP can compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权AI应通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球GDP可10%复合增长。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并不显而易见；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; saying no to good ideas is crucial for focus.
murati.zh: AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展；对好主意说不对于保持专注至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based is key.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；基于时间至关重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 让人类参与其中对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink for generative, fault-tolerant UIs.
gustav.zh: 2023年，AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需为生成式与容错界面重新思考。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerges from simple scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023年，LLM 本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能源于简单的 Scaling 而非复杂性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphones; real gains require rebuilding infrastructure, not hype.
gustav.zh: 2025年，AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，真正收益来自重建基础设施而非炒作。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; marginal inference cost forces new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025年，生成式 AI 实现双向对话式产品，推理边际成本迫使商业模式变革。

gustav.en: Leadership tenure and trust enable functional orgs; AI should give users control, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026年，长期任期与信任使职能组织可行；AI 应赋予用户控制权而非成瘾性。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot achieve mathematical AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026年初，提出仅靠非正式模型的规模扩张无法实现数学AI，形式验证对可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is a key bottleneck, shifting focus to formal methods.
carinahong.zh: 从2026年初到年中，强调自动形式化比证明更难，无解陈述的形式化是主要瓶颈，因此转向形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just for safety but scales brilliance, improving sample efficiency and enabling open collaboration across domains.
carinahong.zh: 2026年中，提出形式验证不仅用于安全，更能扩展才华，提升样本效率，并促进跨领域的开放协作。

carinahong.en: Lean-based systems excel in structured math but struggle in creative areas; human taste remains crucial even with superhuman AI.
carinahong.zh: 2026年中，指出基于Lean的系统在结构化数学中表现出色，但在创造性领域受限；即使有超人AI，人类品味仍不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is the path to superintelligence, applicable to coding and safety-critical domains.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，非正式推理与形式验证的结合是通往超级智能的路径，并适用于编程和安全关键领域。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit or trends.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅仅追求利润或潮流。

jonyive.en: Simplicity requires joy and humanity; minimalism without soul is desiccated.
jonyive.zh: 简洁需要愉悦和人性；没有灵魂的极简主义是干瘪的。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计的本质；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025年，我认为AI进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化能力参差不齐，需要谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，OpenAI转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向；开源模型因主权需求而持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，我认为存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统被黑客攻击等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical; open source is safer due to scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023年，我认为小模型也能高效且经济；数据质量至关重要；开源因可审查而更安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024年，我强调效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要；价值正转向应用层和企业落地。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; AI augments jobs, not replaces.
mensch.zh: 2025年，我主张将AI视为机遇；主权AI需掌控数据与基础设施；AI增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026年，我认为模型正商品化；差异化在于垂直专业化与定制；AGI是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; open source and enterprise engagement are key; AI sovereignty is universal.
mensch.zh: 2026年，我强调欧洲需AI战略自主；开源与企业深度合作是关键；AI主权对每个国家都重要。

reinerpope.en: Initially focused on inference economics: batch size and memory bandwidth dominate cost, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 最初关注推理经济学：批大小和内存带宽主导成本，而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Argued models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
reinerpope.zh: 认为由于推理成本，模型过度训练约100倍于Chinchilla最优。

reinerpope.en: Shifted to hardware primitives: multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays are key, data movement dominates.
reinerpope.zh: 转向硬件原语：乘加运算和脉动阵列是关键，数据移动占主导。

reinerpope.en: Emphasized low precision (FP4) yields superlinear gains due to quadratic scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 强调低精度（FP4）因位宽二次方缩放带来超线性收益。

reinerpope.en: Consistently highlights memory bandwidth and data movement as bottlenecks over compute.
reinerpope.zh: 始终强调内存带宽和数据移动是瓶颈，而非算力。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software; execution is cheap, so build prototypes fast.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年3月：AI的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件；执行成本低，应快速构建原型。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not on complex scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年3月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应聚焦于能力和安全，而非复杂脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI; kids excel because they haven't learned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年5月：主要差距在于人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可交给AI；孩子因未学会设限而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; ideal AI interaction is asynchronous, judge by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年5月：明确任务用Sonnet，开放任务用Opus；理想的AI交互是异步的，以最终效果评判。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude rather than just correcting mistakes; treat AI as a collaborator in problem-solving.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年5月：与Claude一起调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误；将AI视为解决问题的协作者。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 的共同核心；预训练的 Scaling 收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools and long context enable agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；工具和长上下文使智能体行为超越静态权重。

oriol.en: Post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math/coding generalizes broadly, reducing need for broad training.
oriol.zh: 后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海；数学和编程上的窄域强化学习泛化良好，减少了对广泛训练的需求。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, video are core to AGI; video/image GPT moment not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是 AGI 的核心；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents via non-parametric file-system storage; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆通过非参数文件系统存储解决；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024年，RLHF是最流行的微调技术，并将因行业投资而持续存在。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement.
lambert.zh: 2024至2025年，后训练的数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据带来10倍改进。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2025年，RLVR是后训练的最大突破，实现了推理和工具使用。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models, and this gap may persist.
lambert.zh: 2025至2026年，开放模型落后于封闭前沿模型6-9个月，这一差距可能持续。

lambert.en: Chinese labs focus on meticulous engineering, not paradigm invention; open models gain influence.
lambert.zh: 2026年，中国实验室专注于精细工程而非范式发明；开放模型获得影响力。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers spend less time mocking up, more on execution and vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死；设计师花在原型上的时间减少，更多投入执行和 3-6 个月的前瞻愿景。

jennywen.en: Embrace designer archetypes like block-shaped generalists and cracked new grads; speed and judgment over taste.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：拥抱块状通才和“破解版新毕业生”等设计师原型；速度与判断力胜过品味。

jennywen.en: Consistently values craft, intuition, and human judgment over rigid processes.
jennywen.zh: 始终：一贯重视工艺、直觉和人类判断，而非僵化流程。

jennywen.en: Shift from questioning process to declaring it dead; from intuition to archetypes and speed as core.
jennywen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：从质疑流程转变为宣告其死亡；从直觉转向原型与速度为核心。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，实现更好的泛化。

pathak.en: Scaling robot learning requires diverse data sources; pretraining on videos/simulation and post-training on real data is essential.
pathak.zh: 从2020年到2026年，观点深化：扩展机器人学习需要多样数据源，预训练（视频/仿真）加后训练（真实数据）是关键配方。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment is a technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026年，提出机器人学是数据问题，通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但部署是技术挑战。

pathak.en: Consistent focus on generalization and scaling, from curiosity-driven exploration to data flywheels.
pathak.zh: 始终关注泛化与扩展，从好奇心探索到数据飞轮，主线贯穿始终。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; end-to-end learning and distillation shrink cognitive cores.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；端到端学习和蒸馏可缩小认知核心。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems, not utilities; Software 3.0 is prompt-based, and agents need a decade of careful oversight.
karpathy.zh: LLM 更像操作系统而非工具；软件 3.0 基于提示，智能体需要十年谨慎监督。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed, synthetic data collapses, and cognitive cores may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可能很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agentic engineering means directing agents, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 自十二月起我不再写代码；智能体工程意味着指挥智能体，而理解仍是人类瓶颈。

askell.en: Initially, model welfare is a low-cost moral safeguard; treat models well despite uncertainty, as it shapes future human-AI relations.
askell.zh: 最初（2025-12），认为模型福祉是低成本道德保障；在不确定性下善待模型，因为这会影响未来人机关系。

askell.en: By 2026, model welfare is tied to consciousness uncertainty and avoiding resentment; excessive corrigibility is risky, favoring virtue ethics over rigid rules.
askell.zh: 到2026-04，模型福祉与意识不确定性及避免怨恨相连；过度可纠正性有风险，倾向美德伦理而非僵化规则。

askell.en: Later, transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability, while future models may need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 后期（2026-04），强调AI价值观和训练目标透明化对问责至关重要；未来模型可能需要更少明确指导、更多自主判断。

askell.en: Consistently, models are unique entities shaped by training, not human analogs; treat them with respect and care, balancing philosophy with engineering.
askell.zh: 始终认为，模型是由训练塑造的独特实体，非人类类比；应尊重和关怀，并在哲学与工程现实间平衡。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge as systems become more powerful; governance must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 随着系统变得更强大，AI 对齐成为紧迫挑战；治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习来实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding it in products is crucial.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，提供可解释性；将其隐藏在产品中至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处前移试探。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表示、推理和个性化。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable driver needs massive data and compute.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质是AI问题；扩展可泛化驾驶员需要海量数据和算力。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short and medium term; infrastructure and data quality are key.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费车辆规模将超过Robotaxi；基础设施和数据质量是关键。
