turley.en: Model as product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs; chat is not final interface.
turley.zh: 2025年：模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代、每日发布以了解用户需求；聊天不是最终界面。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, accelerated for product development.
turley.zh: 2025年：安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格把关，产品开发则尽量加速。

turley.en: Vision: personalized AI assistant with context and actions, amplifying human capability, not replacing.
turley.zh: 2025年：愿景是拥有上下文和行动能力的个性化AI助手，增强而非取代人类能力。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investment, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026年：北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products; reasoning models transformative when seamless.
turley.zh: 2026年：下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

carlpei.en: Brand is core, not afterthought; survival first; start simple, prove yourself before complex products.
carlpei.zh: 品牌是核心而非事后考虑；生存第一；先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; hardware becomes commodity, AI is key.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动智能体软件；硬件商品化，AI 是关键。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditized, price war coming; focus on applied AI for consumers, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化，价格战将至；聚焦面向消费者的应用型 AI，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI is ingredient, not marketing hook.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是最快的差异化手段；AI 是配料，而非营销噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interface could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能取代；应用将消失。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress requires deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进展需要深度人工评估，而非优化排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools require human judgment; doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 工具需要人类判断；医生可能因锚定和谄媚而表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: AI in medicine must prioritize safety over accuracy; omission risk is greater than commission.
edwinchen.zh: 医学 AI 必须将安全置于准确性之上；遗漏风险大于误报风险。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024年，我认为AI在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉在结合真值检测器后，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AlphaGo marked a transition where AI surpassed human intelligence in specific domains.
kohli.zh: 2026年，我强调AlphaGo标志着AI在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是推动AI超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，像代码这样可验证的领域对AI超越人类知识至关重要。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
nando.zh: 2023年，他认为AI应像显微镜一样增强人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体（如Gato）是通往AGI（通用人工智能）的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely to AI development.
nando.zh: 2026年，他强调AI安全是最大的开放挑战；非洲能跨越遗留问题，为AI发展做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终认为多样性和包容性对构建有益AI至关重要；沟通等人文技能与编码同等重要。

nando.en: From focusing on scaling and generalist agents to emphasizing safety and responsible deployment in real-world contexts.
nando.zh: 从2023年关注Scaling（规模扩张）和通用智能体，到2026年转向强调安全与负责任部署，视角从技术转向应用与治理。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，强调具身对AI知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Real-world data is scarce; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从2023年到2026年，持续认为真实数据稀缺，仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的关键。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning a messy house) is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理乱屋）作为具身AI的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; system one (low-level control) remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，预测智能机器人数量2040年超过iPhone，且系统一（低级控制）仍是具身AI最难部分。

jimfan.en: GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years; home use longer due to safety and unstructured environments.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，认为机器人领域GPT-3时刻约5年内到来，但家庭应用因安全和环境非结构化需更久。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024年：设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool, not static guidelines.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024至2026年：品牌策略从动态表达平台深化为招聘工具，而非静态指南。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and hire diverse archetypes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026年：设计成为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并招聘多元原型人才。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026年：速度与决断优于完美；在快速创业公司中，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Give designers ownership and autonomy; adapt process to problem, not universal templates.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终：赋予设计师自主权；流程应适应问题，而非套用通用模板。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能；微调可能因长上下文和动态专业化而过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI without new breakthroughs. Agents need reliability.
sholto.zh: 2025年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加RL或可达成AGI；智能体关键在于可靠性，而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator; verifiable rewards drive progress. Agentic coherence (30h) expands tasks; RL enables new skills.
sholto.zh: 2025至2026年，我认为编码是领先指标，可验证奖励驱动进步；智能体连贯性（如30小时）扩展任务范围，RL让模型学会新技能。

sholto.en: Capability overhang exists; orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence. Compute is the bottleneck; software-only singularity possible.
sholto.zh: 2026年，我指出能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要；算力成瓶颈，软件单点奇点可能先于物理世界实现。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023年，我认为仅靠Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更优的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从2023年起，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; AI must go beyond human knowledge, using abductive reasoning for science.
yejin.zh: 2025年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈，AI需超越人类知识，通过溯因推理推动科学发现。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training, rewarding information gain, improves reasoning and yields lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2025至2026年，我主张在预训练阶段引入强化学习，奖励信息增益，以提升推理能力并带来持久收益。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can outperform frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026年，我倡导多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性，并认为使用多样化合成数据的小模型可超越前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; quality is iterative debt; AI is a creative partner; code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；质量是迭代的债务；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools are outdated; AI enables real progress; being too visionary can fail; design and engineering merge.
nadchishtie.zh: 传统设计工具过时；AI 带来真正进步；过于远见可能失败；设计与工程融合。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; portfolios should show craft, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 拥有端到端执行能力并用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值；作品集应展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; generalists beat specialists; AI adoption is expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 小规模设计与工程团队优于跨职能团队；通才胜过专才；采用 AI 是预期行为。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024年，认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024年，提出推理时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一波AI进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Shift from viewing agents as promising but not yet super useful to emphasizing human-AI collaboration and iterative refinement.
truell.zh: 从2024年认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，到2025年更强调人机协作与迭代细化。

truell.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025年，认为未来编程将转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍居主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 2025年，强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and talent; alignment is key. PhD and critical thinking are paths.
leike.zh: 2018年：AI安全需要实证研究和人才，对齐是关键；读博和批判性思维是路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse costs are vital.
leike.zh: 2024年：OpenAI安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不足；外部监督和提高滥用成本至关重要。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023年，他认为基于下一个词预测的大模型是AI完备的，规模扩张带来智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term opportunity; future models need trillion-token contexts and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期机会，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but alone won't achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration, and open-source models narrow the gap.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他认为AGI的经济影响被低估，编码应用被低估，因其加速AI自我进化，开源模型缩小差距。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018年，强调自博弈和模仿学习为机器人技能获取提供强信号；强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not hard-code assumptions.
abbeel.zh: 2021年，主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强，而非硬编码进网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks, hinting at broader AI.
abbeel.zh: 2021年，指出预训练语言模型内化通用推理模式，可迁移至非语言任务，暗示更广泛的AI能力。

abbeel.en: Consistently values learning from interaction and data-driven approaches over hard-coded rules in robotics and AI.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视从交互和数据驱动中学习，而非在机器人和AI中硬编码规则。

abbeel.en: Real-world robotics requires high reliability (99.9%) and generalization across tasks, moving from lab to practical value.
abbeel.zh: 2021年，强调现实机器人需高可靠性（99.9%）和跨任务泛化，从实验室走向实际价值。
